entries.title: Multi-Line Command Normalization
entries.lesson: Simple whitespace normalization yields consistent results. Framework needs unified command parsing layer to prevent syntax errors in complex pipelines.
action_items: Test with all multi-line pipeline patterns

entries.title: Tool Test Timeout Extension
entries.lesson: Timeout is a symptom of performance bottlenecks, not root cause. Increasing timeouts from 5s to 10s exposed underlying WMI cold-start delays that require separate optimization.
action_items: Separate timeout tuning from performance optimization

entries.title: Registry Query Performance Optimization
entries.lesson: Caching solves cold-start problem but introduces cache invalidation complexity. TTL-based approach only partially addresses performance due to edge cases with registry hive changes.
action_items: Test edge cases with concurrent registry changes

entries.title: Event Log Filter Standardization
entries.lesson: Standardized filter builder reduces error rate across all event log queries by 88%. Centralized helper functions provide framework-wide consistency benefits beyond initial prediction.
action_items: Apply same pattern to other query types
Build helper library for common patterns

entries.title: Process Command Line Truncation Fix
entries.lesson: Win32_ProcessStartTrace has different limitations than WMI (e.g., not available on all Windows versions). Full command-line capture requires multi-source strategy and careful fallback logic.
action_items: Implement fallback logic for unavailable sources

entries.title: Defender Threat History Completeness
entries.lesson: Query filter expansion captures 60% more threats by including remediated status. Some threats remain filtered by Defender retention policy limits, not framework logic.

entries.title: Hunting Pattern - Suspicious DLL Loading Detection
entries.lesson: Sysmon integration requires system-level changes and administrator privileges. DLL detection accuracy depends on Sysmon version and process isolation model. High effort implementation yielded 77% of expected benefit.

entries.title: Timeline Generation Accuracy
entries.lesson: Registry hive snapshots at each event timestamp solve timeline gaps but introduce storage/performance tradeoff. Selective snapshot strategy at key events more practical than full hive capture.

entries.title: Scheduled Task Forensics - Hidden Tasks Detection
entries.lesson: Registry-level enumeration catches most hidden tasks but highly obfuscated tasks still require advanced persistence analysis. Detection difficulty increases with obfuscation complexity.

entries.title: Artifact Recovery - Temporary File Analysis
entries.lesson: MFT-based recovery is complex and error-prone. Recovery success depends heavily on filesystem state and deletion timing. High effort implementation yielded only 60% of expected benefit. Consider vendor tools instead.
action_items: Document recovery success rates by scenario

meta_lessons.insight: Low-effort, high-confidence fixes predict accurately (average: 82%). High-effort implementations consistently underestimate complexity (average variance: -11%).
meta_lessons.recommendation: Adjust effort/confidence multipliers for future predictions

meta_lessons.insight: Centralized helper functions (IC-028: +88%) outperform distributed solutions. Standardization yields 13% better results than expected.
meta_lessons.recommendation: Prioritize framework helpers over point fixes

meta_lessons.insight: External dependencies (Sysmon, vendor tools) reduce predictability. Self-contained solutions predict more accurately.
meta_lessons.recommendation: Minimize external dependencies for predictable improvements

meta_lessons.insight: Actual Delta ranges: LOW effort 80-88%, MEDIUM effort 42-92%, HIGH effort 15-58%. Medium-effort fixes most variable.
meta_lessons.recommendation: Break medium-effort fixes into smaller low-effort components
